summary: Recover the GIS layer catalogue from a no-match search without changing loaded layers
description:
Exercise a negative search result followed by recovery while real map content is loaded.
Environment: https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/launcher. Use existing authorised access, open GIS and load one test-created Surveyor layer using defaults. Record the visible Map layers list, layer identity, empty Search layers field, Surveyor and a non-Surveyor catalogue entry such as Beacons. Use Search layers, not Search Map.
Acceptance criteria
Before filtering, the unfiltered catalogue shows Surveyor and the recorded non-Surveyor entry; the test-created layer is identifiable in Map layers or the legend.
Entering the deliberately non-matching text TEST2_NO_SUCH_LAYER_20261006 in Search layers makes both recorded catalogue entries absent from the filtered catalogue. The entered search text remains visible and the existing Map layers list is unchanged.
Clearing Search layers restores both recorded catalogue entries and leaves the original Map layers list unchanged, without adding or removing any layer.
A subsequent search for Surveyor shows the matching entry; clearing it again restores the original catalogue and the same loaded layers. No error page or sign-in screen interrupts the search journey.
Do not require a specific no-results message or invent an empty-state label: evidence must show the actual filtered catalogue, search text and complete loaded-layer list. Capture each criterion's own before/after states. Restore the initial search text and remove only the layer created for this test; preserve existing layers.

guideImpact.affectedSection: GIS layer catalogue search and filtering
guideImpact.reason: The delivered behavior changes the user-facing GIS workflow: users can search the layer catalogue, recover from a no-match result by clearing the search, and keep the loaded map layers unchanged. The guide should explain this search-and-clear interaction and its effect on the catalogue versus loaded layers.

guideUpdate.title: Recover the GIS layer catalogue after a no-match search
guideUpdate.affectedSection: GIS layer catalogue search and filtering
steps: In GIS, enter a layer name in Search layers to filter the catalogue.
If no catalogue entries match, clear Search layers to show the full catalogue again.
Search for Surveyor when you need to find the Surveyor catalogue entry.
Clear Search layers to restore the complete catalogue; the loaded Map layers remain unchanged throughout.
screenshotCaptions: A deliberately non-matching value remains visible in Search layers while the catalogue shows no entries.
After the non-matching search is cleared, Beacons and Surveyor (2) are visible again.
Searching for Surveyor filters the catalogue to the Surveyor (2) entry.
After the Surveyor search is cleared, the original catalogue and the same loaded Map layers are restored.
guideUpdate.reason: Amends the GIS catalogue search guidance to explain recovery from a no-match search and confirm that clearing the search restores the catalogue without changing loaded Map layers.
